summary: The selected continuation keeps one sole owning plan and preserves finite pilot acceptance. Delivered CLI/native selection and Observation-only writer source does not establish installed Project 3 acceptance. Paired programme, organization driver, check, recovery, reporting and cross-repository consumer sources are prepared together with explicit supported runtime model/effort routes, original owners/holds and the six reporting user-delta intents. They grant no live switch or organization V1 fallback; existing authorized issue/plan/native-PR work continues while installed, migration, UI and real-use gates remain open. Canonical generator retirement removes only organization V1 projected guidance; product contracts remain isolated. The selected migration source route is typed prepare/apply/readback in the existing packaged board-v2 CLI/shared GitHub adapter under a separate exact migration authorizer, never an expansion of Observation-only authority or a fork of the historical offline importer. Prepare binds a complete predecessor snapshot and semantic delta with unresolved new native IDs; accepted readback supplies actual IDs before final stable enrollment and positive installed inspection/refresh/selection. Preserve existing Status option identities/card values; default writes no existing human planning fields. Native lack of conditional/CAS updates requires scoped owner coordination or an explicit no-write disposition, not a claimed GitHub lock. Supported API view configuration does not establish grouping/sort/column order or visual acceptance. Retain exact original request custody, one-shot effects, readback-only uncertain reconciliation, no automatic retries and zero writes for an unchanged reconciled repeat. This decision authorizes source preparation only; publication, actual installed identity, native mutation admission, UI verification, coordinated adoption and manual-v3-status retirement remain separate gates.
title: Prepare coordinated current-only consumers and bounded packaged Project 3 migration
